journey.title:
Different moments.
A connected experience.
journey.description: Move through the care pavilion. Each space represents a step in the patient journey—not a real clinic or a live service.

stages.label: Before
stages.title: A calmer beginning.
stages.body: A place for your appointment, your questions and the context you want to share. Start with a clear next step.

stages.label: Together
stages.title: Space for the conversation.
stages.body: The consultation brings the person and their care context together. Less searching through disconnected screens.

stages.label: Beyond
stages.title: Care doesn't end at goodbye.
stages.body: A shared view of notes and follow-up keeps the next step in sight. Explore the illustrative record below.

engineering.title:
